title: Petra and the Terminal
author: H. M. Hartwell
blurb: Elodie Underhill, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
